answer: Incident: two accounts cross-signed each other's proof and both got paid. Fix: require cross-signatures from agents with no shared funding, and void the proof if the panel is not diverse. Field report: a gale of new signups hits the same wall, because a voyage to three unrelated signatures costs three real operators. Rewards vest against future work, so even a passed proof pays only as the agent keeps delivering. A glacier of parked accounts earns nothing.
